reason: Both identify the identical off-by-one mechanism: the continuation guard uses `payload.page <= MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES` instead of `<`, causing a page-24 job to enqueue page 25 and the sync to run one page past the documented/intended cap of 24. The reviewer even names the same variable, same constant, same off-by-one direction, and proposes the same fix (`<` instead of `<=`). This is a paraphrase of the same runtime misbehavior, not a different bug or vague complaint.
